description: This file provides Romanian language localization strings for the Select2 JavaScript plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to delete excess characters when input is too long.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to input more characters when input is too short.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message shown when more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message shown when a search is in progress.
